SPEHSS MAHWEEN!

That being said, i would love it if they made something like this where you could play as an Ork. Or a Sister Of Battle. Or a Howling Banshee. or a  Daemonette. Or a Tech Priest. There's so much lore in 40k, but for the most part all we get is space smurfs. This game is legit tho, so buy it.

Not being able to listen to audio logs as you play, but having instead to stop playing, and go into the menu, means that I did not listen to them, and they wasted money on voice actors I will never hear.

The keys are rebind-able which is fantastic, but you can only do that, or even view the controls for that matter, in the main menu/title screen, not in menus during the game.

Also did they really have to pick the space smurfs? Seriously. Nobody likes them. Literally every other spehs mahween chapter is cooler. Space Wolves and Angry Marines being prime examples.

You do get sort of stuck on terrain in some places.

Game never drops below 110 fps on my system :)

9/10 spehs mahweens.
More brutal than the old testament

I personally like the Warhammer Series as well as the Warhammer 40,000 series. Both are great, but the games at time can be a little lackluster. However, from the very start of this game is a series of events that continuously make me want to replay it. Even on Easy this game is a challenge. From the start there was and is about 20 - 50 Orks to kill and that is just a nomal part of the tutorial part of the opening. I love this game and recommend it for not only Warhammer fan, but for any fan of a good challenge.

Dear SEGA, if you want to save this game, there are 3 things you MUST do:
-add community-made servers
-add steam workshop support
-add bot matches
Thank you and keep up the good work!
Could have been good, but the controls are incredibly clunky, to the point where it interferes with the gameplay.
